usedFor: CoachingOS holds your coaching leads and Graphy holds the courses, so “Fetch Leads” can run “Create a Learner”.

bestTemplate.name: “Fetch Leads” in CoachingOS, then “Create a Learner” in Graphy
bestTemplate.why: New leads get a learner account in Graphy, the step before “Enroll Learner to Course”.

watchOut: “Create a Learner” needs an email ID and a name, so leads missing either will fail.
